round3.scope: targeted, not a full round: the two apps the round-2 target killed, plus two controls
round3.change: WebView library redirect ordered ahead of the OH .z.so naming fallback in the bionic shim's dlopen; the fallback's early 'return plain' had made the redirect unreachable for every library that also exists in the runtime directory

root_cause.kind: dead code in our own shim, not a missing symbol
root_cause.detail: two libandroid.so ship. runtime copy: 117 defined FUNC, 0 ASurface*, 0 of the 14 Chromium looks up, and it is FIRST on the search path. webview-t-lib copy: 115 defined FUNC, 27 ASurface*, 14 of 14, and it is LAST. dlopen therefore succeeded against the runtime copy and every dlsym returned null.
root_cause.regressed_by: the .z.so fallback commit, added after the redirect commit and placed above it
root_cause.why_per_caller_redirect_is_still_correct: the two copies share only 34 symbols; redirecting every caller to the WebView copy would lose 83, including the ACanvas, AHardwareBuffer and ALooper families
